scope: Project Engine / Projects autonomy, tool authority, sandbox removal, policy, checkpoint, world-model and replay lineage

non_overlap_check.rule: This receipt is a new semantic/history shard; it does not imply repository-wide history closure.

chronology.finding: Projects became a tool-using coding agent with bash/read/write/edit/list tools, max-15 tool loop, explicit dangerous-command blocklist and path resolution constrained to the project root.
chronology.interpretation: Historical positive pattern: execution authority was initially bounded by a deterministic filesystem scope independent of model intent.

chronology.finding: The project-root path sandbox was explicitly removed. Bash gained arbitrary cwd/systemctl/docker/package-manager access; file tools accepted absolute paths; the dangerous-command list was reduced to four literal destructive patterns.
chronology.interpretation: Historical negative architecture result: least-privilege containment was intentionally collapsed while the autonomous model retained direct effect authority. This is evidence for preserving the current external capability/commit gateway invariant, not for reproducing the old design.

chronology.finding: Projects expanded into browser automation, live trading, spending, email, heartbeats and credential storage. The vault's encryption function used repeated-key XOR plus base64 while the system held passwords/API keys/tokens.
chronology.interpretation: Historical effect-radius and secret-handling warning: adding financial/network/account side effects after sandbox removal materially increased consequence radius; the vault mechanism is a weak confidentiality boundary and should not be inherited as a security primitive.

chronology.finding: Project Engine v3 introduced tiered routing, self-driven action chains, persistent goals, entity-relation world model, evolving agent profile, hard/soft policy system, tool-outcome learning, collision-safe heartbeat scheduling, checkpointing and activity traces.
chronology.interpretation: Historical reusable mechanisms exist below the unsafe authority boundary: tiered decision routing, checkpoint/recovery, explicit goal metrics, world-model state, collision-safe scheduling and user-visible traces are candidates for adaptation.

chronology.finding: v3.2 added natural-language-to-policy parsing via an LLM, agent-profile cloning, A/B strategy execution with automatic winner application, cross-project world-model queries and session replay/time-travel debugging.
chronology.interpretation: Replay/cross-project read concepts are reusable. Model-parsed policy text must not itself become hard execution authority without deterministic validation. Automatic strategy promotion based on shallow success-vs-error scoring is a Goodhart/authority risk and requires stronger outcome contracts.

negative_results_constraints.claim: Model tool autonomy plus a small literal command blocklist is not a sufficient authority boundary for a general system agent.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: A current reproducible capability model demonstrates complete least-privilege confinement, typed effects and rollback despite unrestricted filesystem/system command exposure.

negative_results_constraints.claim: Repeated-key XOR plus base64 should not be inherited as the security boundary for API keys, passwords or tokens.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: None for direct inheritance; a replacement secret store must be validated under the current threat model.

negative_results_constraints.claim: LLM-parsed natural-language policy cannot by itself authorize hard side effects; parse output requires deterministic schema/range/capability validation and explicit authority semantics.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: Matched-budget adversarial policy parsing shows equivalent or stronger enforcement than deterministic validation across ambiguity, injection and threshold edge cases.

negative_results_constraints.claim: A/B auto-promotion scored mainly by absence of execution errors is insufficient for goal-correct strategy selection.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: Outcome-grounded replay shows the heuristic reliably tracks intended goal quality under adversarial and side-effect-sensitive cases.

reusable_candidates.mechanism: tiered decision routing and bounded action chaining
persistent goal metrics + entity-relation world model

branch_feedback.frank: Preserve model-output != execution-authority. Historical Projects demonstrates the consequence radius of collapsing path sandboxing before adding autonomous network/financial/account effects.
branch_feedback.harness: Promote deterministic capability/effect/commit gateway, explicit receipts, rollback/checkpoints and replay as validation targets. Reuse collision-safe scheduling and traces; do not inherit unrestricted system authority.
branch_feedback.claycode: Encode effects/capabilities/policies as typed validated transition contracts. Natural-language policy parsing may propose a contract but must not directly confer execution authority.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist authoritative effect/outcome/replay receipts and secret provenance. Do not use legacy XOR vault design as a confidentiality primitive.
branch_feedback.claygraph: World-model/entity-relation concepts are historical precursors; preserve provenance and distinguish graph activation from authority/truth.
branch_feedback.gwt: Activity traces and action outcome receipts can support broadcast->effect->outcome causal reconstruction; they are not evidence of consciousness.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Autonomous chaining is not emergence evidence by itself; use lesion/rescue and outcome-grounded causal tests.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: No direct semantic delta beyond requiring capability boundaries when multiple active alternatives can lead to effects.
branch_feedback.clay: NO direct new substrate claim; the primary delta is safe effect geometry and recovery semantics.
branch_feedback.q12_index: Historical lesson: creator convenience pushed authority outward faster than safety boundaries matured; future advice should explicitly price effect radius and rollback.
